name: outlook-local-mcp
description: Manage Microsoft Outlook calendars, events, and email directly from Claude. Runs entirely on your local machine — data stays on your device.
long_description:
A local MCP server that connects Claude to your Microsoft Outlook account via the Microsoft Graph API.

## Features

- **Calendar management**: list, create, update, delete, cancel, reschedule, and respond to events
- **Free/busy lookup**: check availability across time ranges
- **Email access**: list folders, search messages, manage drafts and allowlisted local attachments
- **Per-account risk profiles**: calendar-only, mail read, draft management, or human-confirmed draft send
- **Multi-account**: add and switch between multiple Microsoft accounts
- **Recurrence support**: create and expand recurring events (daily, weekly, monthly, yearly)
- **Teams integration**: create events with automatic Teams online meeting links

## Privacy & Security

- Runs as a single binary on your machine — no cloud relay, no proxy
- OAuth tokens stored in your OS keychain (macOS Keychain / Windows Credential Manager)
- Only connects to Microsoft Graph API with your explicit consent
- Delegated permissions are selected per account: User.Read, Calendars.ReadWrite, and only the configured Mail.Read, Mail.ReadWrite, or Mail.Send scopes

tools.name: calendar
tools.description: Calendar operations for Microsoft Outlook via Microsoft Graph. Owner-primary and explicitly selected mounted calendar list/get/search reads use account-scoped aliases, exact mailbox-view routes, and signed target-bound event references. Organizational mounted aliases with manage capability also support create/update/reschedule/delete only when Graph explicitly reports zero attendees and no online-meeting capability, on the exact recipient-view route; shared meeting actions remain excluded. Omitting an alias preserves own-calendar behavior. Required operation: help (detailed docs), list_calendars, list_events, get_event, search_events, create_event, update_event, delete_event, respond_event, reschedule_event, create_meeting, update_meeting, cancel_meeting, reschedule_meeting, get_free_busy.

tools.name: mail
tools.description: Mail operations for Microsoft Outlook via Microsoft Graph. The selected target's exact action policy authorizes each operation. Organizational shared-mail folder, message, search, conversation, and attachment reads use configured owner-view routes and signed target-bound references; raw output keeps Graph-derived data beside a provenance sidecar. Includes own reads, drafts, add_attachment (allowlisted local file), and send_draft (human-reviewed existing draft send).

tools.name: account
tools.description: Account management for Microsoft accounts. Required operation: help, add, remove, list, login, logout, refresh, set_mail_policy (independent own-mail actions), and legacy set_mail_profile migration input.

tools.name: system
tools.description: System diagnostics, authentication utilities, and embedded documentation access. Required operation: help (detailed docs), status (server health, accounts, config), complete_auth (finish auth_code flow — only when auth=auth_code), list_docs (list embedded documentation slugs), search_docs (keyword search across embedded docs), get_docs (fetch full content or a section by slug and anchor).

client_id.title: Microsoft Application (Client) ID
client_id.description: The app used to access Microsoft Graph. Default: 'outlook-desktop' (Microsoft Office, works out of the box with device_code auth). Use 'outlook-local-mcp' for the project's own app registration. To use browser auth, register your own app in Entra ID with http://localhost redirect URI and paste the client ID here.

tenant_id.title: Entra ID Tenant ID
tenant_id.description: Your Entra ID tenant. Use 'common' (default) for any Microsoft account, 'organizations' for work/school only, or 'consumers' for personal accounts only. Advanced: paste a specific tenant GUID to restrict access to a single organization.

auth_method.title: Authentication Method
auth_method.description: How you sign in to Microsoft. 'device_code' (default): visit a URL and enter a code — works everywhere, no app registration needed. 'browser': opens your browser automatically — requires your own app registration with http://localhost redirect URI. 'auth_code': manual flow for headless/remote environments.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: Your timezone for calendar operations (IANA format). Use 'auto' to detect from your system, or specify explicitly, e.g. 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London', 'Asia/Tokyo'. Defaults to 'auto'.

mail_enabled.title: Default Mail Read Access
mail_enabled.description: Legacy and implicit default mapping that enables the own-mail read action. Explicit new accounts default all actions off.

mail_manage_enabled.title: Default Draft Management
mail_manage_enabled.description: Legacy and implicit default mapping that enables own-mail read and draft actions.

mail_send_enabled.title: Default Confirmed Draft Send
mail_send_enabled.description: Legacy and implicit default mapping that enables own-mail read, draft, and human-reviewed send actions.

attachment_roots.title: Allowed Attachment Directories
attachment_roots.description: OS path-list of directories from which mail.add_attachment may read local files. Empty disables local upload.
